newsitem.title: USA: Miami airport sees boost in international cargo.
newsitem.headline: Miami airport sees boost in international cargo.

text.p: International freight volume at Miami International Airport jumped to 129,040 tons in May, a 9.1 percent increase over May of last year, the Metro-Dade County Aviation Department said Wednesday.
Domestic cargo tonnage decreased by 1.7 percent to 27,854 tons in May. Combined freight tonnage increased by 7 percent to 156,894 tons.

International passenger traffic rose by 6.7 percent in May, to 1.18 million, while domestic passenger traffic rose by 7.5 percent to 1.61 million. Combined passenger traffic rose by 7.16 percent to 2.8 million in May.
Aircraft operations for the month increased by 3.6 percent to 44,872 operations, an average of 1,447 operations per day.
